summary: @christyirish1 #LRA18 has had plenty of OER study groups and ad-hoc open access committees. They write a report, the board does nothing, rinse and repeat. Same pattern for over decade We spent three years trying to move to an open source website and research repository....got shut down and replaced with commercial project. author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@christyirish1 #LRA18 has had plenty of OER study groups and ad-hoc open access committees. They write a report, the board does nothing, rinse and repeat. Same pattern for over decade

We spent three years trying to move to an open source website and research repository....got shut down and replaced with commercial project.

LRA too addicted to journal revenue to make any real moves towards open scholarship
